recommendation: Keep the core source fix. If the Extension Pack is reviewed separately, its valueSetTitle status-reason metadata can be checked for consistency, but no further core source change is needed for FHIR-40715.
issue_request: FHIR-40715 was an Applied/Persuasive vocab issue requesting deprecation of http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/valueset-compose-include-valueSetTitle and guidance to use http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/display for value set titles. The approved resolution called for deprecation metadata and description/definition text on the extension page.
initial_application: The extension definition had moved out of core with the R5 extension move. In the FHIR Extension Pack, commit 2d8d6741385fe7229cd5fbeb5ee276ec0abe31a5 explicitly included FHIR-40715 and added deprecated standards-status metadata plus description/definition text pointing to StructureDefinition-display. Core still had active ValueSet narrative from the FHIR-36015 VSD notes work, later link-fixed by b3e3733, that recommended the deprecated valueSetTitle extension.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists valueset=ValueSet, so source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml is in build scope for the current core ValueSet page. The Extension Pack display extension is active and scoped to canonical references, matching ValueSet.compose.include.valueSet. January 2024 Terminology Infrastructure WGM minutes mention FHIR-40715 among extension tickets, and targeted Zulip search found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Changed source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml to recommend the display extension on ValueSet.compose.include.valueSet and to state that the earlier valueset-compose-include-valueSetTitle extension is deprecated. No core extension-definition edit was made because the definition now belongs to the FHIR Extension Pack and already contains the requested deprecation text.
source_changes: source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml: replaced guidance to use ValueSet.valueset-compose-include-ValueSetTitle with guidance to use StructureDefinition-display on ValueSet.compose.include.valueSet and marked the older extension deprecated.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-40715 cites FHIR-40711 as a similar value set extension deprecation/removal decision, but FHIR-40711 concerns the separate valueset-systemTitle extension and was not needed for the seed fix.
